uniqueAngle.existingConsensus: The company CRM is the rep's system of record.
uniqueAngle.keelClaim: The company CRM is the company's system of record — reps have always run a private layer for what actually matters, and it deserves better than a notes app.
uniqueAngle.supportingReason: The CRM records what the org needs reported; the rep needs what the org never asks for.
